name: Arrays
description: Core linear data structure covering 1D/2D arrays, prefix sums, sliding window, and two pointers.

name: Binary Search
description: Logarithmic search paradigm on sorted arrays, search spaces, and answer spaces.

name: Sorting
description: Comparison and non-comparison sorting algorithms and their interview applications.

name: Hashing
description: Hash tables, frequency maps, prefix hashing, and collision resolution.

name: Linked Lists
description: Singly, doubly, and circular linked lists with pointer manipulation and cycle detection.

name: Stack and Queue
description: LIFO and FIFO structures, monotonic stacks, and deque sliding windows.

name: Heap
description: Priority queues, min/max heaps, top-k patterns, and median streams.

name: Recursion & Backtracking
description: Recursive state trees, permutations, combinations, and pruning.

name: Trees
description: Binary trees, traversals (BFS/DFS), and binary search tree properties.

name: Trees II
description: Advanced tree structures including AVL/BBST, Tries, and Segment Trees.

name: Graphs
description: Graph representations, BFS/DFS, topological sort, Dijkstra, MST, and APSP.

name: Greedy
description: Local optimization heuristics leading to globally optimal solutions.

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, memoization, and tabulation.

name: Math
description: Number theory, modular arithmetic, combinatorics, and geometry.

name: Miscellaneous
description: Bit manipulation techniques, rolling hashes (Rabin-Karp), and string algorithms.
